<subject>Reminder -- Last Day to Provide Input on Naming of Meridian Law & Advisory LLP Staff Lounge!</subject>
<body>
As Meridian finalizes plans for our staff lounge scheduled to open during the 3rd quarter of next year, we are seeking input on 5 alternative names/concepts for the naming of our lounge. If you've already given feedback, THANKS!

If you have not, please take 5 minutes of your time to stop by 4th Floor Breakout Room from 11-1 TODAY to give us your opinion.

Feel free to bring a friend! FREE pastries will be provided!

Please forward this email to any other Meridian employees that may want to provide their  input on the naming of the lounge.

We look forward to seeing you later today!

Regards,
Grace Elliott
Executive Assistant
Meridian Law & Advisory LLP
020 7183 8383
London EC2V 7EA
</body>
